title: Synthesis, characterization, biomolecular interaction, potent aqueous singlet oxygen generation and NADH photo-oxidation of phenanthroline-based cyclometalated Ir(III) complexes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,45145-45156
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06269A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bhumika Joshi, Rishav Das, Rinku Chakrabarty, Murugesh Shivashankar, Priyankar Paira
A phenanthroline-based cyclometalated Ir(III) complex has been synthesized, which shows efficient biomolecular interaction and potential application in singlet oxygen generation and NADH oxidation.
